name: codeowners-check-skill
description: Agent skill that shows what a CODEOWNERS file really does and proves that an edit only changes the intended paths.

plugins.name: codeowners-check
plugins.description: Resolves and verifies CODEOWNERS (GitHub and GitLab) with an offline standard-library script: owner and deciding line per file, skipped and shadowed rules, and a before/after ownership diff.
